snippet.title: The Beatles - The Beatles - In My Life (Official Music Video starring Owen Cooper) ft. Owen Cooper
snippet.description:
Directed by Jessica Swale and Irina Alexiu
 
Watch the official video for The Beatles' 'In My Life’, written and directed by 2 x Olivier Award winner Jessica Swale and Irina Alexiu and featuring Emmy, BAFTA and Golden Globe winner, Owen Cooper.
 
A love letter to The Beatles' hometown, Liverpool, the film follows the journey of a treasured ukulele as it sparks a relationship, creates an enduring bond between mother and son, and inspires a love of music that passes through a family over the decades.
 
‘In My Life’ is from the Beatles' sixth album, Rubber Soul, originally released on December 3rd, 1965.

snippet.title: LITTLEFOOT | Official Trailer | Land Before Time Reimagining
snippet.description:
TODAY, WE GET TO SHARE SOMETHING TRULY SPECIAL.

Three years of hard work. Countless setbacks. More challenges than I can possibly put into words. And now, after a journey that first began back in 2017, we finally get to show the world what we've been working on and what better day to do it than the 38th anniversary of THE LAND BEFORE TIME. The film that inspired so many of us, and the reason this little dinosaur means so much to so many people.

We've brought together an incredible team of artists, animators, musicians, filmmakers and voice actors from around the world. Every single person has given their time, talent and passion to make this happen, simply because they believe in this story.

To our cast, hearing these characters come to life through voices I've grown up listening to has been one of the most surreal experiences of my life.

To our crew, what you've managed to achieve, often against impossible odds, is nothing short of extraordinary.

This isn't just a film about a little dinosaur. It's a love letter to the stories that stay with us, the people who bring them to life, and what can happen when a group of people refuse to give up on a dream.

So today, on the anniversary of the film that started it all, we're incredibly proud to finally share this with you.

**THE LITTLEFOOT TRAILER IS OUT NOW.**

► Site: https://www.imoriapictures.co.uk/
► IG! https://www.instagram.com/joeythedirector
► Discord! https://discord.gg/gdQqUFZrB

snippet.title: The Comeback King | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Fall hard. Come back stronger. 
Watch The Comeback King trailer now. 

Pre-save The Comeback King - Soundtrack: https://comebackking.ffm.to/soundtrack
Featuring original songs sung by Glen Powell and Madelyn Cline. 
-----
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@thecomebackkingmovie
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thecomebackkingmovie
X: https://twitter.com/_comebackking_
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thecomebackkingmovie
Official Site: https://thecomebackkingmovie.com

Judd Apatow and Glen Powell partner to write a new original comedy directed by Apatow, a film that joins Apatow’s lineage of defining comedy classics, including The 40-Year-Old Virgin, Knocked Up and Trainwreck. The Comeback King charts the rise, crash and comeback of a country music star who checks out, grows up and learns a little along the way.

Powell, star of Hit Man, Twisters and Top Gun: Maverick, trained in guitar and singing to perform a number of songs penned by some of Nashville’s foremost songwriters in this love letter to country music.

The Comeback King stars Powell as Aubrey King, a hot-shot country sensation whose songs about drinkin’ and lovin’ are fueling his rise but are leaving him feeling like a commodity, exacerbated by the fact that he’s dating the world’s biggest pop superstar, Missy (Madelyn Cline; Outer Banks, Glass Onion). 

After Aubrey discovers that he is not Missy’s one-and-only and breaks up with her, an irate Missy goes on offense and releases a track that makes Aubrey the cheater, sending his life and career into a rapid downward spiral. 

Faced with a mandatory timeout, Aubrey dodges the spotlight and returns to college to finally finish his degree and discover what he wants to say in his music, sparked by Sam, a no-nonsense professor (Emmy winner Cristin Milioti; The Penguin, The Resort) who is initially unimpressed by the celebrity crashing in her classroom. 

The film’s top-flight comedic cast includes Stavros Halkias (Tires, Bugonia) as Aubrey’s unconventional manager and breakout Li Jin Hao (Mitchell and Webb Are Not Helping, Tomorrow is a Long Time) as Jeff, Aubrey’s sweet roommate whose quiet demeanor hides virtuosic surprises. 

The all-star supporting cast includes stand-up phenom Leanne Morgan (Leanne), Oscar® nominee Kumail Nanjiani (The Big Sick), Emmy nominee Vanessa Bayer (SNL), Atsuko Okatsuka (Father), Oscar® and Emmy nominee Tig Notaro (Star Trek: Starfleet Academy), Emmy nominee Chris Fleming (Chris Fleming: Live from the Palace), Emmy nominee Mike Birbiglia (Trainwreck) and Big Fella (Cookin’ Wit’ Big Fella). 

The Comeback King also features appearances by a cavalcade of country music superstars including Jelly Roll, Brad Paisley, Miranda Lambert, Shaboozey, Chris Stapleton, Brandi Carlile, Luke Bryan and Reba McEntire. 

Written by three-time Emmy winner and Golden Globe nominee Judd Apatow and by SAG Award-winner and two-time Golden Globe nominee Glen Powell, The Comeback King is directed by Apatow and produced by Kevin Misher (Coming 2 America, Richard Jewell), Apatow, Powell and four-time Emmy nominee Dan Cohen (Backrooms, Stranger Things). The executive producers are Barry Mendel and Josh Church.

snippet.title: 🔥 DJ PARTY 71 – REWIND THE NIGHT | Eurodance / Hip House / Techno #2026music
snippet.description:
“REWIND THE NIGHT” blends classic Eurodance energy, old-school Hip House attitude and a darker modern techno groove.

Driven by a deep punchy kick, rolling bass, bright Eurodance synths, rave piano accents and sharp techno stabs, the track moves at 104 BPM with a heavy, hypnotic club pulse. Male Hip House rap verses meet a catchy female chorus, while reverse-vocal effects and the signature “Re-re-rewind” hook create the feeling of turning time backward.

The arrangement builds through filtered grooves, heartbeat-style bass pulses, vocal whispers and rewind effects before opening into powerful drops with wide synths and strong low-end impact.

🎧 Artist: DJ PARTY 71
🎵 Title: REWIND THE NIGHT
⚡ BPM: 104
🎶 Style: Eurodance / Hip House / Techno Groove

Turn it up, bring the night back and hit rewind.

The park is finally open! 

Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards. Sounds like vacation to me. 

Dizzyworld – where magic sometimes happens 

KEY FEATURES: 
– Experience all rides from a first-goat perspective 
– Use a scooter to rest your tired hooves, or get into a bumper car for a free whiplash 
– Cotton candy. If this isn’t a selling point, I don’t know what is 
– Visitors and staff have been added for that real-life amusement park feeling 
– New goats, gears, achievements, and map to meh around with 
– Switch your emotional roller coaster for a real one. Or at least an in-game one 
– A jam-packed playground with lots to explore 
– Sandbox gameplay à la OG Goat Simulator

snippet.title: GTA 6 ULTIMATE BEGINNERS GUIDE! 32 Tips You NEED to Know (Don't Make These Mistakes)
snippet.description:
GTA 6 BEGINNERS GUIDE: GTA 6 Tips & Tricks You NEED To Know!
►If you enjoyed the video, please consider hitting 👍 LIKE and ✅ Subscribe for more!
►https://youtu.be/iO_WVL3jVx8?si=1z7Hc-tLejTa4008

The ULTIMATE GTA 6 beginners guide: 33 GTA 6 tips and tricks I wish I knew before I started playing. After 10+ hours in Leonida on PS5 Pro, here's everything you need to know to protect your money, build up Jason and Lucia, lose the cops, and get the best possible start in Grand Theft Auto VI. Every tip is checked in my own game, and there are no story spoilers.

💰 MONEY Cash in your pocket is gone when you die or get busted. Hide it under the floorboards in Jason's bedroom, then bank it at an ATM once the bank unlocks in the mission Buck Me. Loot bags are lost on death too, but guns you've bought come back. Loot enemies you take down for cash, ammo and weapons.

💪 GYM, FOOD & FOCUS Work out 3 days in a row to build strength and Focus. Weights build strength and health, cardio builds stamina, and eating at home gives you a buff. Click both sticks for Focus to see enemies through walls, safe codes and alarmed doors. Petting animals and helping neighbours fill your Focus back up.

🚓 THE POLICE Cops aren't on your minimap anymore. They find you through witnesses and cameras, so change your car colour, your look and your outfit to get away. Register stolen cars, and watch out for cars with trackers.

🚗 CARS Scan cars with the WAiNK app before stealing them, get free repairs at Joey's, watch your fuel, use Paradise Taxi to fast travel, use the car controls for windows, headlights and hazards, and shove your car back over if you flip it.

🗺️ EXPLORING The full map starts hidden under fog. Walk, drive or fly over each area to reveal it, and check the Exploration tab for neighbour favours. Sleep to skip time, and repair your house.

🎯 FIRST PERSON There's no first-person mode, but certain gun attachments let you aim in first person.

👩 PLAYING AS LUCIA You first play as Lucia in Day Release at the end of Chapter 1, but you can't swap freely between her and Jason until Chapter 2. Then hold Right on the D-pad to switch.

💬 Which tip didn't you know? Tell me in the comments, and share your own tips for other new players. 🔔 SUBSCRIBE for more GTA 6 guides, secrets, cheat codes and map locations.

snippet.title: GTA 6 PS5 Pro Gameplay - 15 Minutes of The First Mission
snippet.description:
While this may not be the very first minutes of Rockstar’s latest Grand Theft Auto, it is taken from the first proper mission of the game, which takes place after a short prologue. The reason for this? We think it would be nice for you to experience the start of the story for yourself, and it means we can avoid any potentially cool reveals or spoilers in that story-heavy prologue and focus on the gameplay itself.

In the roughly 15-minute section, you’ll see Jason, alongside his friends Cal and Donnie, complete a little drug-running operation near Key Lento — part of GTA 6’s fictional Florida Keys archipelago. You’ll get to check out just how stupidly gorgeous that water looks, a blend of both stealth takedowns and loud gunplay action, as well as some of that trademark Rockstar humour. Enjoy!

snippet.title: GTA 6: Five Things You NEED To Do First
snippet.description:
Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following Grand Theft Auto V (2013), and the sixteenth entry overall. Set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, and in the fictional city of Vice City, based on Miami, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Players are able to freely roam Leonida's open world.

Preliminary work began in 2014 following the release of Grand Theft Auto V, with principal production starting after the launch of Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018. Rockstar's global development teams more than doubled since Red Dead Redemption 2. Miami and its surrounding areas were extensively researched for the game's world, which parodies 2020s American culture. The protagonists' dynamic is inspired by the notorious outlaw duo Bonnie and Clyde, and the non-player characters (NPCs) were written to ensure players experience different areas of Vice City.

Following years of speculation and anticipation, Rockstar confirmed in February 2022 that the game was in development. That September, footage from unfinished versions was leaked. Grand Theft Auto VI was formally revealed in December 2023. It became the most preordered video game of all time, with estimated sales exceeding 17 million digital copies, generating over $1.6 billion in revenue prior to launch. Following two delays, further leaks, and an extensive marketing campaign, it was released on 19 November 2026 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S to universal critical acclaim. It tied The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998) to become the highest-rated video game on Metacritic[a], and it is the only game from the 21st century to achieve an overall score of 99.

snippet.title: GTA 6 Review
snippet.description:
Reviewing GTA 6 has been a blast thanks to Rockstar sparing no effort to create the most ambitious open world it’s developed to date and backing that up with a story, cast, and gameplay loop that often intersect with style. Leonida is going to take a lot of your time once you set foot in it, and not a minute of it is going to feel like a waste.

You get to be whoever you’d like to be in its streets, and you can sure that the world is going to get back to you about the things you do in it. We’ve covered as much ground as we can with this one and left the rest for you to experience. Join us as we take you around the city and perhaps let you decide if its sights and sounds are alluring enough for you to dive into right away.

Note: Varun Karunakar contributed to this review.

snippet.title: GTA 6 Disappointing Launch
snippet.description:
GTA 6 is finally out, and launch day turned into a highlight reel of bugs, broken physics and people falling straight through the map. The beach from the trailer is almost empty, a plane door doesn't even open, and everyone is calling it "Cyberpunk 2077 all over again". I called this in my last video, so in this one I go through everything players found on day one, the physics, the bugs, the missing details, the 30 FPS and the 10/10 reviews, and then explain why none of it actually matters.

snippet.title: 50 GTA 6 Easter Eggs & Secrets!
snippet.description:
TheTruthHurts: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xqELudeidF8&t=33s
Nfxce: https://x.com/nfxce_
Ezqilo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4wnhEN7Umjc

50 Easter Eggs & Secrets in GTA 6! From a dog riding a jet ski to a UFO abduction in Port Gellhorn, we’re hunting down some of the strangest GTA 6 Easter eggs, secrets, and mysteries hidden across Leonida. Some are easy to miss even when you’re looking right at them. One of my favorite GTA 5 callbacks is something you’ll recognize with your eyes closed.

🏠 Jason’s safehouse is packed with Rockstar references. We take a look at Michael’s boat, a GTA 5 map, and the wind chimes that longtime players will recognize as Michael De Santa’s ringtone. There’s also a Fabian magazine, a Liberty City reference in Lethal by Design, and ORCA’s parody of David Goggins.

🛸 GTA 6 UFOs and aliens get their own deep dive. We visit the UFO house, investigate the Port Gellhorn abduction, and explore two alien labs. One of the best clues is small enough to fit on a bumper. The Lil’ Probe’Inn sticker reads “Introvert but willing to talk about the 1992 Area 69 incident,” a callback to GTA San Andreas.

🌴 GTA 6 mysteries take us from the Grassrivers Skunk Ape to the meteor crater and strange rock formation on Mount Kalaga. Along the way, we find Grand Senora Desert postcards, a secret bunker, a monster crab, and a snake jump scare. Keep an eye out for the bird’s nest, too.

🎮 GTA 6 cameos and Rockstar callbacks include Tommy Iguana, the purple hippo, Mr. Raspberry Jam, and the lawn gnomes. We also check out Dexter’s apartment rooftop and the NPCs up there, a New Austin license plate for Red Dead Redemption fans, a Drug Wars Easter egg, and Race and Chase 7. Even the vehicles hide details, from working turn signals to the ability to push a car.

Which of these 50 GTA 6 secrets did you find first? If you’ve spotted an Easter egg I missed, drop the location and what to look for in the comments so I can check it out for the next ZacCoxTV video.

Credits for the alien lab finds go to @TheTruthHurts and @nfxce. Credit to @GTABase for the Drug Wars Easter egg.

#GTA6 #GTA6EasterEggs #GTA6Secrets

Discover a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Each new game offers a different starting point and experience, allowing you to collect resources and survive in abandoned locations and roads.

This tutorial walks you through the necessary PS5 console settings to configure your system for account sharing. By navigating to the user management menu, you can set your machine as the primary PS5 to ensure your digital content is accessible to other users on the same device.

snippet.title: GTA 6 is a Psyop, Here's Why.
snippet.description:
GTA 6 launched with a 99 on Metacritic. A wave of players say it isn't even that good. So why did the world stop for Grand Theft Auto 6?

I think GTA 6 is a psyop. I don't mean a leaked memo or a government program. I mean a show big enough to keep a hurting public quiet, which is the oldest trick in the book. That's my opinion, and I give six reasons for it, with every source on screen.

In this video: the launch day backlash against GTA VI, the 2,500 year old story of a nation that played games to get through a famine, bread and circuses in Rome, what Edward Bernays and Aldous Huxley said out loud about controlling a crowd, what a brain scan study found about video games and dopamine, Elon Musk's "universal high income," and what happened when I dropped out of college to play World of Warcraft.

I like games, and I have nothing against Grand Theft Auto or anybody playing it today. I just think you should look up while you play.

Is GTA 6 a psyop, or is it just a game? Tell me in the comments.

CHAPTERS
0:00 GTA 6 is a psyop
1:28 Reason 1: The game isn't even that good
2:44 Reason 2: The oldest trick in the book
4:23 Reason 3: A famine of our own
8:04 Reason 4: Rome did it on purpose
9:15 Reason 5: Bernays and Huxley said it out loud
11:05 Reason 6: It worked on me
12:52 Bread and a circus, April 2026
14:28 "It's just a company making money"
15:39 Where the evidence stands
17:07 Why I think it's spiritual

SOURCES SHOWN ON SCREEN
Herodotus, Histories 1.94 (the Lydians): https://cts.perseids.org/read/greekLit/tlg0016/tlg001/perseus-eng2/1.94.1-1.94.7
Fronto, Principia Historiae (Loeb, vol. 2, p. 217): https://www.loebclassics.com/view/marcus_cornelius_fronto-correspondence/1919/pb_LCL113.217.xml
Juvenal, Satire 10 (bread and circuses): https://pages.pomona.edu/~cmc24747/sources/juvenal/juv_10.htm

snippet.title: Dream Cheated, But Not Alone...
snippet.description:
Dream said every speedrun on his channel was still verified. But the guy who first counted his pearls turned out to be faking world records himself, and he wasn't the only one. FlowBee faked six runs, NikocraftHD's record got eleven million views before a hunger bar gave it away, and this October the same investigators went back to Dream's own world records...

Huge shoutout to the people who actually caught all of this: @EleventyBillion, @Eliotex, @MrMangoHands, @KarlJobst, @TheWeeklyThing, @pikaJ, @LowestPercent and @NiceTwice, plus the Minecraft speedrun moderators (Geosquare, Crafterdark, Feinberg, Krystl), Ninjabrain and Matthew Bolan. Go watch their videos, they did the hard part. FlowBee's own words are from his interview with @LewisFulham.

snippet.title: The GTA 6 Review Scandal Is Pure Fraud
snippet.description:
GTA VI is a perfect game. At least, that's what the mainstream gaming publications would have you believe, with a seemingly endless parade of 10/10 reviews and perfect scores. But there's a rather inconvenient problem with that narrative. IT"S A LIE! Gaming Journalism Is Broken, And GTA 6 Proves It.
Support the channel with a one off donation https://paypal.me/BluntNate or become a regular supporter; https://www.patreon.com/BluntNate


GTA VI has demonstrable performance issues, including frame-rate drops into the low 20s on the standard PlayStation 5 during heavy action. Even Digital Foundry's technical analysis acknowledges that the game struggles to maintain its 30FPS target in certain scenarios... even on the PS5 PRO!

So why are so many professional reviewers handing out perfect scores and giving it a pass for technical issues they would, have have, penalized OTHER games for?

#GTA6 #GTAVI #RockstarGames #GamingJournalism #GamingReviews #DigitalFoundry #PS5 #GamingIndustry 

We've seen other critically acclaimed games lose points for performance problems. Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, Elden Ring, Baldur's Gate 3 and plenty of others have all faced scrutiny for their technical shortcomings.

So why does GTA VI apparently get a free pass?

Are these reviews actually evaluating the games they're supposed to be reviewing, or have mainstream gaming publications become another extension of the marketing machine?

And when a game costs $125 AUD, shouldn't we expect a little more honesty from the people supposedly helping us decide whether it's worth buying?

Maybe it's time we started demanding a little more accountability from gaming journalists & a whole lot less marketing disguised as journalism.

Maybe it's time we started demanding a little more accountability from gaming journalists & a whole lot less marketing disguised as journalism.

snippet.title: GTA 6 - Everything We Learned in the First 24 Hours Tips, Prices & Secrets
snippet.description:
GTA 6 is finally out, and this is everything we learned in the first 24 hours. I went through hours of launch-day gameplay and every review and guide that went live on launch day, and checked each claim against the footage: the first-boot settings you should change before the first cutscene (Navigation Experience, L3 sprint, mute licensed music), how the opening plays (spoiler-light, with a warning), the Keys and the first trip into Vice City, Jason's stilt house and the body stats, the phone, the Waink car scanner and the HUD, money and the stash, real day-one prices from Ammu-Nation to the burger counter, how the cops and wanted levels work (and the $59 shirt that removes your outfit heat), cars, boats and planes, the best tiny details, what disappointed people (30 fps, saves, no online), the PS5 problems seen on launch night, and what to expect next.

What was the first thing you did in GTA 6, and how many times did you get busted? Tell me in the comments - I'm reading all of them.

GAMEPLAY FOOTAGE (launch day, 18 November 2026) - huge thanks to these creators, go watch and follow them:
- youtube.com/@AlpHaRoaZ (4K no-commentary playthrough)
- youtube.com/@DubStepZz (4K no-commentary playthrough)
- youtube.com/@GamersPrey (4K no-commentary playthrough)
- youtube.com/@Shirrako (4K no-commentary playthrough)
- youtube.com/@Sirloin1 (4K no-commentary playthrough)
- youtube.com/@TheGamingRevo (4K no-commentary playthrough)

Streamer voices were removed and stream overlays cropped out; clips are short and used for commentary and criticism.
